from: The FIA Formula One Race Director
incident_time: 18:15 2022 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 06 - 09 October 2022 Note to Teams Due to the additional tyres being supplied under Article 30.2 a) ii) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the following concession will be made: On Friday, 7 October 2022 the curfew will be extended by a period of THREE HOURS for a maximum of SIX operational personnel for the sole purpose of tyre preparation post tyre fitting from the tyre supplier. The FIA Formula One Race Director Eduardo Freitas
title: Event Note Curfew Extension
